name: Hollow Chain Auditor
loreTies: A contract-thing that writes debts no one agreed to, born where Infernal ambition meets Gate erasure.
Taxes repeated abilities and punishes greedy burst rotations.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Chain Auditor is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into elite battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Chain Auditor formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Taxes repeated abilities and punishes greedy burst rotations. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A contract-thing that writes debts no one agreed to, born where Infernal ambition meets Gate erasure.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Chain Auditor can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Chain Auditor visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses bent accountant-devil silhouette made of chains and ledgers, no eyes, burning white contract seams. while its abilities — Unowned Debt, Chain Levy, Clause Snare — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
